scientific_integrity: Every all-length statement follows from the structural lemma and exact four-state transfer identity. Finite calculations are supporting checks, not the infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to fan graphs and named optimal colorings only. Full text of Pang, Miao and Fan DOI 10.1016/j.disc.2025.114683 was not accessible; possible overlap remains. Unindexed prior literature remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp strong odd coloring transition and complete optimal-coloring census of fan graphs
